source.document_title: საქართველოს მთავრობის 2026 წლის 15 სექტემბრის №447 დადგენილება — წყლის რესურსების მონიტორინგის დაგეგმვისა და განხორციელების წესის დამტკიცების შესახებ

scope.note: State environmental water-resource monitoring is not the same dataset or legal test as potable-water supplier compliance under Government Decree №58/2014 or NFA food-control sampling.

monitoring_modes.purpose: Characterize water bodies, confirm pressure/impact assessment and identify long-term natural and anthropogenic trends.
monitoring_modes.frequency_basis: Risk-based; consider hydromorphological and hydrogeological conditions, pressures and assessment objectives.

monitoring_modes.purpose: Monitor at-risk water bodies, significant pressures and effectiveness of measures.
Investigate pollution incidents/accidents or unknown causes of failure to achieve good status.

interpretation_limits: This is an environmental water-resource monitoring framework, not evidence of potable-water compliance or a laboratory result.
The listed annexes were not downloaded or inspected; no parameter lists or annex sampling frequencies are asserted.
The annual plan deadline is a planning duty, not proof that a plan or any sample was completed.
Operational monthly/quarterly frequency applies to the operational monitoring mode described by the rule, not to every station or every analyte.
Groundwater monitoring applies to hydrogeological units until groundwater bodies are defined; station-level coverage is not inferred.
Public access is subject to environmental-information, data-protection and confidentiality law.
No station identifiers, sample-level observations, coordinates or private data are included.
